user.description: This development preview provides custom integration inventory and on-demand static scans. Scan results are saved in Home Assistant storage until you clear them or turn saving off. It does not provide update alerts or establish safety.

abort.already_in_progress: Doorcheck setup is already in progress.

init.description: Saved results keep the reviewed scan and the latest scan of each scanned integration in Home Assistant storage. Backups include them. Turning saving off deletes them.

scan_integration.name: Scan one custom integration
scan_integration.description: Scan a bounded private copy of one installed custom integration directory. Static observations do not establish safety.

directory.name: Integration directory
directory.description: The exact directory name shown by Get custom integration inventory.

get_inventory.name: Get custom integration inventory
get_inventory.description: Read declared manifest facts from custom integration folders. This does not scan their code or establish safety.

get_results.name: Get saved scan results
get_results.description: Read the reviewed scan and the latest saved scan of one custom integration without scanning again.

directory.name: Integration directory
directory.description: The exact directory name shown by Get custom integration inventory.

mark_reviewed.name: Mark scan as reviewed
mark_reviewed.description: Make the latest saved scan of one custom integration its reviewed scan. Later scans are compared with it.

directory.name: Integration directory
directory.description: The exact directory name shown by Get custom integration inventory.

digest.name: Scan SHA-256
digest.description: The installed-files SHA-256 of the latest saved scan.

clear_results.name: Clear saved scan results
clear_results.description: Delete all saved Doorcheck scan results, including results that could not be read.

scan_busy.message: A Doorcheck scan is still running. Wait before requesting another.

scan_invalid_directory.message: Select one custom integration directory name, without a path.

inventory_not_configured.message: Set up and enable Doorcheck before requesting an inventory or scan.

results_clear_invalid.message: Clear saved scan results takes no fields.

results_incomplete.message: Only a scan with complete coverage can become the reviewed scan.

results_invalid_request.message: Send the integration directory and the 64-character SHA-256 of its latest saved scan.

results_not_found.message: No saved scan exists for this integration directory.

results_not_saving.message: Saving scan results is turned off or unavailable.

results_stale.message: This is no longer the latest saved scan. Open the latest result and try again.
